title: How far does a hash-only sender go? A pre-registered map of sender memory versus bits for short text messages
abstract: arXiv:2611.09848v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a sender that only computes hashes, with a language model only at the receiver, transmit short human text more cheaply than a classical sender trained on the same domain? We answer with one pre-registered run on 1,000 English user utterances from Taskmaster-1. The primary endpoint is the cost per message to deliver 100% of the messages (hash bits, plus a 2-byte negative acknowledgement and the raw text when the first attempt fails), paired against an in-domain PPM order-1 sender. The hash-only sender delivered 857 of 1,000 messages on the first attempt and cost 192.8 bits per message, 18.4 bits more than PPM order 1 (95% bootstrap interval 10.9 to 26.3); by the pre-registered rule it spends more and is not equivalent within one byte. As secondary results we map measured sender memory against bits. The hash-only sender (8,190 B on a host build, keyed BLAKE2b tag included, as in every method) was the cheapest point in bits from 8,190

translated_title: 仅哈希发送端能走多远？短文本消息中发送端内存与比特数的预注册映射
translated_abstract: 一个仅计算哈希的发送端（语言模型仅存在于接收端），能否比在同一领域训练的经典发送端更便宜地传输简短的人类文本？我们通过一项在 Taskmaster-1 数据集 1,000 条英文用户话语上进行的预注册实验来回答这个问题。主要终点是 100% 送达所有消息所需的每条消息成本（哈希比特，加上 2 字节的否定确认以及首次尝试失败时的原始文本），并与领域内的 PPM 一阶发送端进行配对比较。仅哈希发送端在首次尝试中成功送达了 1,000 条消息中的 857 条，每条消息成本为 192.8 比特，比 PPM 一阶多 18.4 比特（95% 自助法置信区间为 10.9 至 26.3）；根据预注册的判定规则，它花费更多，且不等价于一字节以内。作为次要结果，我们绘制了实测发送端内存与比特数之间的关系图。仅哈希发送端（在主机构建中为 8,190 字节，包含密钥化的 BLAKE2b 标签，与其他所有方法相同）是从 8,190
tldr: 本研究通过预注册实验发现，仅计算哈希的发送端传输短文本的每条消息成本比领域内 PPM 一阶发送端多 18.4 比特，不满足成本等价标准，但其以约 8KB 的极小发送端内存成为内存-比特权衡中比特数最省的方案。
en_tdlr: Through a pre-registered experiment, this paper shows that a hash-only sender costs 18.4 bits per message more than an in-domain PPM order-1 sender for short text transmission, but with only ~8KB of sender memory it offers the cheapest bits on the memory-versus-bits tradeoff.
